name: Conflict Finder
author: WP Fix It - WordPress Experts

sections.description:
Conflict Finder is a powerful, admin-only troubleshooting plugin designed to help WordPress site owners, developers, and support professionals quickly identify the cause of site issues.

From a single interface, you can temporarily disable plugins, switch themes, enable and manage WP_DEBUG settings, view and clear the debug log, and test email delivery.

Conflict Finder automatically tracks your original configuration and ensures it can be restored at any time, allowing you to isolate problems quickly and confidently.

Key Features

  • One-click disable and restore plugins
  • Safe theme switching for conflict testing
  • Enable and manage WP_DEBUG without FTP or server access
  • View and clear the WordPress debug log directly from the admin area
  • Test if site is delivering emails

Why Use Conflict Finder

  • Quickly determine if a plugin or theme is causing an error
  • Avoid FTP access or manual file edits
  • Safely debug live sites
  • Designed specifically for administrators and support workflows
  • Clean, modern UI focused on clarity and speed
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file to your WordPress admin under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or extract the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Conflict Finder through the Plugins menu.
  3. Access the tools under Tools → Troubleshoot.
sections.faq:
Do I need FTP or server access?

No. Conflict Finder allows you to manage debugging and troubleshooting directly from the WordPress admin.

Is this safe to use on live sites?

Yes. The plugin is designed specifically to avoid impacting non-admin users.

For questions, support, or suggestions, please visit:
https://www.wpfixit.com/contact
